results.question: What colors and orientations is the Game Master Screen available in?

answer.text:
The Game Master Screen is available in several colors and orientations:

- **Colors:** Brown, Black, Red, Green, Blue [1]
- **Orientation options:** Portrait, Landscape [1]

The price for the Brown version is $139.99 USD. [1]

The Savage Worlds Magnetic Screen Cover is available in both portrait and landscape orientations. [2] The cover dimensions are 19 x 12 inches. [2]

The Ultimate Bundle (Brown) - Complete Game Master Screen Kit for D&D, Pathfinder & TTRPGs is available in both portrait and landscape orientations. [3] The price for the Brown variant is $35.00 USD. [2]

The Ultimate Bundle (Black) - Complete Game Master Screen Kit for D&D, Pathfinder & TTRPGs is available in both portrait and landscape orientations. [4] The price for the Black variant is not provided in the knowDrive.

The Ultimate Game Master Screen - Magnetic Modular DM Screen for D&D, Pathfinder & TTRPGs is available in both portrait and landscape orientations. [1] The price for the Brown variant is $139.99 USD. [1]
